capabilities: Render SVG images from frontmatter-defined objects, layers, and views
Edit renders by drag-and-drop in a preview panel with grid, zoom, and pan
Preview renders as an interactive 3D globe with selectable map projections
Embed renders in notes via sketchmatter code blocks
Export the current render as an SVG file
disambiguation: Not a freehand drawing tool; images are defined by frontmatter on notes, not drawn on a canvas.
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; ships a demo vault in /sketch-matter-demo-vault; globe previews require WebGL and remote textures are subject to CORS.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to build vector images from structured data in note frontmatter.
summary: Frontmatter-driven SVG renderer that turns tagged object, view, and image notes into layered vector images with a preview panel.
